title: Find the subintervals
text: Here $$f(x)=\frac{1}{1+x^3}$$. The width of each subinterval is $$\frac{3-0}{6}=0.5$$. The endpoints of the subintervals are $$0$$, $$0.5$$, $$1$$, $$1.5$$, $$2$$, $$2.5$$ and $$3$$.

title: Apply the rule
text: Compute $$T_6=0.25\left(f{\left(0\right)}+2f{\left(0.5\right)}+2f{\left(1\right)}+2f{\left(1.5\right)}+2f{\left(2\right)}+2f{\left(2.5\right)}+f{\left(3\right)}\right)$$, which comes out to about $$1.153$$.
